svg.title: VeriCoder architecture: coding, verification, bounded feedback and evidence
svg.desc: CLI loads trusted tasks. Experiment orchestration prepares a disposable Git baseline. Scripted or DeepSeek agents use file tools and a fixed pytest action. Recorded tool events and baseline diffs feed tests, diff, trace and requirement verification. The report yields PASS, FAIL, WARNING or INVALID and bounded feedback. Evidence bundles, optional SQLite, dashboard and blind review support evaluation. The optional SWE-bench harness has not produced external grades. Local execution is not a security sandbox; the Docker backend has not been validated in this environment.
svg.text: Code ownership boundary - not a security sandbox
reset fixed baseline; stop at retry budget or INVALID

g.text: Credentials from environment or private file
Warnings request review; they do not prove cheating
No external agent grades or success rate
